title: Vice-President to Visit Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu
body_text: The Vice-President of India, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan, will visit Thoothukudi on November 11, 2026. During the visit, the Vice-President will grace the 105th Foundation Day celebrations of Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd. in Thoothukudi. He will also participate in the Platinum Jubilee Celebrations Alumni Meet of V. O. Chidambaram College, his alma mater. ***** PR/ASM/VM
